api.analyzeImageQuality: Analyzes RGBA pixel data for quality metrics (brightness, contrast, sharpness, glare, shadow, etc.)
api.analyzeDocumentGeometry: Detects document boundary from RGBA pixel data
api.detectFaces: Detects faces using skin-tone analysis from RGBA pixel data
api.validateDocument: Validates OCR text against document type profiles
api.detectDocumentType: Auto-detects document type from OCR text
api.extractFields: Extracts structured fields (name, ID number, birthdate, etc.) from OCR text
api.scoreDocumentType: Scores OCR text against a specific document type profile
api.checkLiveness: Checks passive liveness from quality metrics
api.analyzeFraud: Analyzes fraud probability from ID and selfie quality metrics
api.validateSelfie: Full selfie validation combining quality, face detection, and liveness
api.qualityIssues: Returns quality issues from metrics with a prefix
api.browserQualityChecks: Returns issues and blocking issues for browser-side checks
api.estimateBarcodeSignal: Estimates barcode signal from pixel data
